title: Mark Zuckerberg’s Social Accounts Hacked

image.attribution: White House (Pete Souza) / Wikimedia Commons / Public Domain.

main_content:
Even Facebook founder Mark Zuckerberg is not safe from cyber attackers.

Zuckerberg’s Twitter, LinkedIn, and Pinterest profiles were hacked over the weekend. His Facebook and Instagram accounts were not involved.

A group calling itself OurMine Team said it attacked the three accounts on Sunday. The accounts were quickly restored.

Twitter says a Twitter account used by the hackers to post messages was suspended. A website called Engadget captured messages posted by the hackers to Zuckerberg’s personal Twitter account.

Business site LinkedIn confirmed Monday that the Facebook founder’s data was compromised. The company said the hackers attempted to create a false profile for Zuckerberg.

The hackers also posted what they claimed was the password used for Zuckerberg’s LinkedIn account.

questions.question: Which accounts (profiles) of Mark Zuckerberg were hacked?
What was his Twitter account used for by the hackers?
options: To create false profiles of Zuckerberg
To post messages claiming to have hacked his accounts
To communicate with other hacked entities
questions.answer: To post messages claiming to have hacked his accounts

questions.question: What did the hackers try to do on LinkedIn?
options: Create a false profile for Zuckerberg
Share private messages from his account
questions.answer: Create a false profile for Zuckerberg
